title: Favorite reading and her mother burning her papers
summary: She read only serious things; her mother burned a bundle of newspaper serial pages fearing reading would make her crazy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, I read everything that was good. Everything that could open my intelligence. Oh, I see. I never read foolishness. Never did love stories and all that. I never did care about that. I like serious things. Now, you see, I tried to follow La Vie, La Fille, Jean La Fille. Oh, yeah. And I had a big bundle of, you know, out of the newspaper. Oh, yeah. My mom said she's gonna go crazy. She burned him up.
Did you read anything in Spanish or German books too?
She thought reading would drive you crazy?
She thought so. I ain't crazy. She's gone. I'm 94 years. I ain't crazy. I'm a long ways from being crazy, yes.
Helped your mind to read those.
I love to read. Oh, I love good literature.
And was, Bill says, was French the only language you could read in?
